newsitem.title: USA: Viking Resources to acquire EPI Systems.
newsitem.headline: Viking Resources to acquire EPI Systems.

text.p: Viking Resources International Inc said Monday that it has agreed to acquire privately-held EPI Systems International Inc. The owner of EPI, said the company, became the chairman and chief executive of Viking in June.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed, but the company said that the acquisition would increase Viking's shareholder equity by $6 million.
EPI is an internationally-oriented recycling company. Viking is a holding company currently pursuing acquisitions in the environmental and recycling fields.
